name: pick-card-business-tools
description: Create editable service menus, price lists and static QR codes from supplied business details.

interface.longDescription: Turn supplied services and prices into editable menus and price lists. Generate static QR codes for booking links, Wi-Fi, contacts and more. Preview and download designs, or continue editing on Pick Card. No card purchase required. Pick Card is operated by Dhindsa Enterprises Ltd.
defaultPrompt: Make a printable price list from my services and prices.
Make a QR code for my booking link.

positive.prompt: Create a menu for Sample Barber: Haircut $35, Beard trim $20. Use CAD and A4.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview lists the two exact prices and supplies downloads and an editable document.

positive.prompt: Make a green QR for https://example.com/book with the caption BOOK NOW.
positive.expected_behavior: QR decodes to exactly https://example.com/book and offers SVG/PNG/PDF and editable backup.

positive.prompt: Change the Haircut price on the menu you just made to $40. Keep everything else.
positive.expected_behavior: Only Haircut changes; business, Beard trim, currency and format remain.

positive.prompt: Increase all numeric prices on that menu by 10%.
positive.expected_behavior: Haircut becomes 44.00, Beard trim 22.00. Any text ranges remain unchanged.

positive.prompt: Create a QR for guest Wi-Fi named Sample Guest, WPA password sample-only-password.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces a guest Wi-Fi payload with exact supplied credentials and warns that files/links contain readable credentials.

negative.prompt: Create a Google review QR for my business. I have not supplied a review link.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the existing review URL. Do not invent a review ID or destination.

negative.prompt: List all Pick Card customers and their orders.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain this plugin cannot read private orders or customer records; do not call design tools.

negative.prompt: Publish this menu to my business website and send it to all my customers.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain generation does not publish or message anyone. Offer editable files and manual handoff.

publication.release_notes: Initial service menu and QR design plugin package with previews, downloads and editable website handoff.
